summary: Practise GloBE scope, ETR calculations, safe harbours and tax-finance workflows. Explore the course and its applied curriculum.
lede: Pillar Two global minimum tax training helps tax and finance teams assess group scope and organize jurisdiction-level calculations. It is intended for multinational group tax and finance professionals, advisers and tax officials who need to connect tax analysis with reporting or administration workflows. Through worked cases, participants practise GloBE income and covered-tax analysis, effective tax rate and top-up tax calculations, safe-harbour assessments, and data controls for preparing a GloBE Information Return checklist.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who assess, calculate, advise on or administer global minimum tax obligations and need to connect tax analysis with group reporting or public administration workflows.
prerequisites: Working knowledge of corporate income tax, financial statements or multinational group finance is recommended. No coding or programming is required. Exercises use spreadsheet-based case calculations; you should have access to a spreadsheet application such as Excel.
